claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition X-01 from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F01-F13; type IMPLIED; BROAD THERAPEUTIC GENERALISATION; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: NO MATERIAL DIRECT EVIDENCE LOCATED. Routing: BUNDLE / GENERALISATION CLAIM — COMPONENT ADJUDICATION REQUIRED. Adjudicated by aggregating the component verdicts across benefits, populations, conditions, timeframes and products; NOT dismissed as untestable.
claim.claim_scope: PRODUCT EQUIVALENCE UNCERTAIN | CONDITION/TIMEFRAME DRIFT | REPLICATION ABSENT
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.claim_text: Premium Grounding produces the advertised benefits across the general audience and listed conditions.
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: Five named conditions unsupported after documented negative search
Immune function unsupported with a discordant marker line
Mechanism chain broken at the provenance step (M-01b NOT ESTABLISHED)
Sleep, stress, energy and recovery genuinely mixed
No exact-product match or replication anywhere
No general-audience, multi-condition or durable programme

evidence_items.text: Component benefits: no component proposition reaches SOLID. M-01a, P-01 and R-01 are QUALIFIED within narrow bounds; S-01, S-03, E-01 and R-01 are mixed; I-01, C-01, S-02, S-04, P-03, P-04 and E-03 are overclaims on surrogate, single, grey or non-isolable evidence.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Isolated positive outcomes exist, which is why the bundle is adjudicated rather than dismissed; but no component supports an unqualified benefit.

evidence_items.text: Component conditions: arthritis, headache, varicose veins, brain fog and immune function retain NO MATERIAL DIRECT EVIDENCE LOCATED after documented proposition-specific negative search confirmed at class A.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Five of the advertised conditions have no qualifying study within the documented routes.

evidence_items.text: Component populations: healthy young men, elite runners, massage therapists, sport students, mild Alzheimer patients, preterm infants, postoperative and hypertensive patients and symptomatic middle-aged women. No representative multi-condition or general-audience cohort was studied.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The advertised audience is not represented anywhere in the evidence.

evidence_items.text: Component timeframes run from 20 minutes to 12 weeks, with durability largely unreported; the advertisement carries no duration qualifier and its present-tense wording cannot inherit durability that studies did not measure.
Component products: no evidence line receives DIRECT PRODUCT MATCH; every proposition carries PRODUCT EQUIVALENCE UNCERTAIN. No proposition has a confirmed exact-product replication.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Generalisation to the advertised product is unsupported at every component.

evidence_items.text: No study of the full proposition exists; no single demonstrated mechanism spans all named conditions, and the chain link 'outcomes generalise to the exact product and all conditions' is frozen as NOT ESTABLISHED.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The bundle itself was never tested.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: Every generalisation dimension — benefits, populations, conditions, timeframes and products — fails independently on the component evidence.
supporting: Isolated positive outcomes in several narrow studies

detected.rationale: Isolated narrow findings in unrepresentative populations are generalised to a general audience across eleven named conditions and an untested product.
The advertised bundle asserts a benefit set that no study tested and that the component adjudication does not support at any component.
Biomarker and acute surrogate evidence underpins a broad durable therapeutic generalisation.

reader_impact.affected_decision_type: Purchase, and management of up to eleven named health conditions.
reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That the product reliably delivers all the advertised benefits for people like them.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: This is the aggregate takeaway a reader forms from the advertisement as a whole, spanning eleven named conditions including progressive and treatable diseases.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: No specific frozen label applies; the error is generalisation across dimensions none of the component evidence supports.
uncertainty.ambiguity: NONE MATERIAL on the verdict — the layers agree. They differ only on how much credit the underlying research programme deserves, which is recorded but does not change the generalisation finding.
missing_evidence: Five named conditions unsupported after documented negative search
Immune function unsupported with a discordant marker line
Mechanism chain broken at the provenance step (M-01b NOT ESTABLISHED)
Sleep, stress, energy and recovery genuinely mixed
No exact-product match or replication anywhere
No general-audience, multi-condition or durable programme
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: A representative multi-condition programme with exact-product data has not been performed. The five condition-level absences remain bounded retrieval findings, not proof of nonexistence.

verdict.verdict_summary: Adjudicated by component rather than dismissed as untestable. Across the twenty-one biomedical component propositions, none reaches SOLID; three are QUALIFIED within narrow bounds; sleep, stress, energy and recovery are mixed; five named conditions have no material direct evidence after documented negative search; immune function is unsupported and its one Earth-contact marker line is discordant; the mechanism chain is broken at the provenance step; no proposition has an exact-product match; and no study tested the bundle, a general audience or durable outcomes.
